const OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Date comparison function
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (dateStr1, dateStr2) => {
    if (!dateStr1 || !dateStr2) return false;
    
    const parseDate = (dateStr) => {
      // Handle MM-DD-YYYY format
      const parts = dateStr.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const [month, day, year] = parts;
        return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      }
      return new Date(dateStr);
    };

    const date1 = parseDate(dateStr1);
    const date2 = parseDate(dateStr2);
    
    return date1 >= date2;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      if (!excelData) {
        setError('No Excel data available');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('Processing Excel data for Org Level Qualitative Analysis...');
        console.log('Excel data:', excelData);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet (note: it has a trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT received Report ',  // With trailing space
            'CSAT received Report',  // Without trailing space
            'Sheet1', 
            'CSAT_Received_Report',
            'CSAT received Report'
          ];
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "CSAT received Report" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert sheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Get headers and data rows
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);

        console.log('Headers found:', headers);
        console.log('Data rows count:', dataRows.length);

        // Find required columns
        const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('unit')
          )
        );

        const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('id')
          )
        );

        const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('name')
          )
        );

        // Note: CSAT Sent Date and CSAT Received Date columns are not displayed but still used for filtering
        const csatSentDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('sent') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        const csatReceivedDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('received') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          csatSentDateIndex,
          csatReceivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (BUSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER NAME) not found');
        }

        // Process data with date filtering
        const filteredData = dataRows
          .filter(row => {
            // Check if row has required data
            if (!row[businessUnitIndex] || !row[customerIdIndex] || !row[customerNameIndex]) {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply date filtering if dates are available
            if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          })
          .map((row, index) => ({
            id: index + 1,
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
          }));

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(processedData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} records matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {processedData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>

            Back
          </BackButton>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>

                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}

                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>

          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

const OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Date comparison function
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (dateStr1, dateStr2) => {
    if (!dateStr1 || !dateStr2) return false;
    
    const parseDate = (dateStr) => {
      // Handle MM-DD-YYYY format
      const parts = dateStr.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const [month, day, year] = parts;
        return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      }
      return new Date(dateStr);
    };

    const date1 = parseDate(dateStr1);
    const date2 = parseDate(dateStr2);
    
    return date1 >= date2;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      if (!excelData) {
        setError('No Excel data available');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('Processing Excel data for Org Level Qualitative Analysis...');
        console.log('Excel data:', excelData);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet (note: it has a trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT received Report ',  // With trailing space
            'CSAT received Report',  // Without trailing space
            'Sheet1', 
            'CSAT_Received_Report',
            'CSAT received Report'
          ];
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "CSAT received Report" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert sheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Get headers and data rows
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);

        console.log('Headers found:', headers);
        console.log('Data rows count:', dataRows.length);

        // Find required columns
        const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('unit')
          )
        );

        const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('id')
          )
        );

        const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('name')
          )
        );

        const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
        );

        const ratingDescriptionIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('rating') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('description')
        );

        const questionCategoryIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('question') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('category')
        );

        // Note: CSAT Sent Date and CSAT Received Date columns are not displayed but still used for filtering
        const csatSentDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('sent') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        const csatReceivedDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('received') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          perspectiveIndex,
          ratingDescriptionIndex,
          questionCategoryIndex,
          csatSentDateIndex,
          csatReceivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (BUSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER NAME) not found');
        }

        if (perspectiveIndex === -1 || ratingDescriptionIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (PERSPECTIVE, RATING_DESCRIPTION) not found');
        }

        // Process data with date filtering
        const filteredData = dataRows
          .filter(row => {
            // Check if row has required data
            if (!row[businessUnitIndex] || !row[customerIdIndex] || !row[customerNameIndex]) {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply date filtering if dates are available
            if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          })
          .map((row, index) => ({
            id: index + 1,
            businessUnit: row[businessUnitIndex] || '',
            customerName: row[customerNameIndex] || ''
          }));

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(processedData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} records matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {processedData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          });

        // Group data by customer
        const groupedData = {};
        rawFilteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
          const ratingDescription = row[ratingDescriptionIndex];

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: Object.keys(groupedData).length + 1,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              NPS: '',
              'Meeting Delivery Commitments': '',
              'Customer Engagement and Relationship': '',
              'Partner adding value to Customer Business': ''
            };
          }

          // Add rating description to the appropriate perspective column
          if (targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
            groupedData[customerId][perspective] = ratingDescription || '';
          }
        });

        const filteredData = Object.values(groupedData);

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(processedData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} records matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {processedData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

const OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Date comparison function
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (dateStr1, dateStr2) => {
    if (!dateStr1 || !dateStr2) return false;
    
    const parseDate = (dateStr) => {
      // Handle MM-DD-YYYY format
      const parts = dateStr.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const [month, day, year] = parts;
        return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      }
      return new Date(dateStr);
    };

    const date1 = parseDate(dateStr1);
    const date2 = parseDate(dateStr2);
    
    return date1 >= date2;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      if (!excelData) {
        setError('No Excel data available');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('Processing Excel data for Org Level Qualitative Analysis...');
        console.log('Excel data:', excelData);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet (note: it has a trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT received Report ',  // With trailing space
            'CSAT received Report',  // Without trailing space
            'Sheet1', 
            'CSAT_Received_Report',
            'CSAT received Report'
          ];
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "CSAT received Report" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert sheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Get headers and data rows
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);

        console.log('Headers found:', headers);
        console.log('Data rows count:', dataRows.length);

        // Find required columns
        const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('unit')
          )
        );

        const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('id')
          )
        );

        const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('name')
          )
        );

        const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
        );

        const ratingDescriptionIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('rating') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('description')
        );

        const questionCategoryIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('question') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('category')
        );

        // Note: CSAT Sent Date and CSAT Received Date columns are not displayed but still used for filtering
        const csatSentDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('sent') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        const csatReceivedDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('received') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          perspectiveIndex,
          ratingDescriptionIndex,
          questionCategoryIndex,
          csatSentDateIndex,
          csatReceivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (BUSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER NAME) not found');
        }

        if (perspectiveIndex === -1 || ratingDescriptionIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (PERSPECTIVE, RATING_DESCRIPTION) not found');
        }

        // Define the specific perspectives we want to include
        const targetPerspectives = [
          'NPS',
          'Meeting Delivery Commitments',
          'Customer Engagement and Relationship',
          'Partner adding value to Customer Business'
        ];

        // Process data with date filtering and group by customer
        const rawFilteredData = dataRows
          .filter(row => {
            // Check if row has required data
            if (!row[businessUnitIndex] || !row[customerIdIndex] || !row[customerNameIndex]) {
              return false;
            }

            // Filter by specific perspectives
            const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
            if (!perspective || !targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply date filtering if dates are available
            if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          });

        // Group data by customer
        const groupedData = {};
        rawFilteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
          const ratingDescription = row[ratingDescriptionIndex];

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: Object.keys(groupedData).length + 1,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              NPS: '',
              'Meeting Delivery Commitments': '',
              'Customer Engagement and Relationship': '',
              'Partner adding value to Customer Business': ''
            };
          }

          // Add rating description to the appropriate perspective column
          if (targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
            groupedData[customerId][perspective] = ratingDescription || '';
          }
        });

        const filteredData = Object.values(groupedData);

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setFilteredData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      setFilteredData(processedData);
    } else {
      const filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredData(filtered);
    }
  }, [searchTerm, processedData]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(processedData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} records matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {processedData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}

};

const OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Date comparison function
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (dateStr1, dateStr2) => {
    if (!dateStr1 || !dateStr2) return false;
    
    const parseDate = (dateStr) => {
      // Handle MM-DD-YYYY format
      const parts = dateStr.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const [month, day, year] = parts;
        return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      }
      return new Date(dateStr);
    };

    const date1 = parseDate(dateStr1);
    const date2 = parseDate(dateStr2);
    
    return date1 >= date2;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      if (!excelData) {
        setError('No Excel data available');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('Processing Excel data for Org Level Qualitative Analysis...');
        console.log('Excel data:', excelData);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet (note: it has a trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT received Report ',  // With trailing space
            'CSAT received Report',  // Without trailing space
            'Sheet1', 
            'CSAT_Received_Report',
            'CSAT received Report'
          ];
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "CSAT received Report" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert sheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Get headers and data rows
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);

        console.log('Headers found:', headers);
        console.log('Data rows count:', dataRows.length);

        // Find required columns
        const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('unit')
          )
        );

        const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('id')
          )
        );

        const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('name')
          )
        );

        const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
        );

        const ratingDescriptionIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('rating') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('description')
        );

        const questionCategoryIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('question') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('category')
        );

        // Note: CSAT Sent Date and CSAT Received Date columns are not displayed but still used for filtering
        const csatSentDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('sent') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        const csatReceivedDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('received') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          perspectiveIndex,
          ratingDescriptionIndex,
          questionCategoryIndex,
          csatSentDateIndex,
          csatReceivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (BUSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER NAME) not found');
        }

        if (perspectiveIndex === -1 || ratingDescriptionIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (PERSPECTIVE, RATING_DESCRIPTION) not found');
        }

        // Define the specific perspectives we want to include
        const targetPerspectives = [
          'NPS',
          'Meeting Delivery Commitments',
          'Customer Engagement and Relationship',
          'Partner adding value to Customer Business'
        ];

        // Process data with date filtering and group by customer
        const rawFilteredData = dataRows
          .filter(row => {
            // Check if row has required data
            if (!row[businessUnitIndex] || !row[customerIdIndex] || !row[customerNameIndex]) {
              return false;
            }

            // Filter by specific perspectives
            const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
            if (!perspective || !targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply date filtering if dates are available
            if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          });

        // Group data by customer
        const groupedData = {};
        rawFilteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
          const ratingDescription = row[ratingDescriptionIndex];

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: Object.keys(groupedData).length + 1,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              NPS: '',
              'Meeting Delivery Commitments': '',
              'Customer Engagement and Relationship': '',
              'Partner adding value to Customer Business': ''
            };
          }

          // Add rating description to the appropriate perspective column
          if (targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
            groupedData[customerId][perspective] = ratingDescription || '';
          }
        });

        const filteredData = Object.values(groupedData);

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setFilteredData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      setFilteredData(processedData);
    } else {
      const filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredData(filtered);
    }
  }, [searchTerm, processedData]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(filteredData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} customers matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            
            <SearchContainer>
              <SearchInput
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by customer name..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              />
              <ClearButton onClick={clearSearch}>
                Clear
              </ClearButton>
            </SearchContainer>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>NPS</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Meeting Delivery Commitments</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Engagement and Relationship</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Partner adding value to Customer Business</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {processedData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

        rawFilteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
          const ratingDescription = row[ratingDescriptionIndex];

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: Object.keys(groupedData).length + 1,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              NPS: '',
              'Meeting Delivery Commitments': '',
              'Customer Engagement and Relationship': '',
              'Partner adding value to Customer Business': ''
            };
          }

          // Add rating description to the appropriate perspective column
          if (targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
            groupedData[customerId][perspective] = ratingDescription || '';
          }
        });

        const filteredData = Object.values(groupedData);

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setFilteredData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      setFilteredData(processedData);
    } else {
      const filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredData(filtered);
    }
  }, [searchTerm, processedData]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(filteredData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} customers matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            
            <SearchContainer>
              <SearchInput
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by customer name..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              />
              <ClearButton onClick={clearSearch}>
                Clear
              </ClearButton>
            </SearchContainer>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>NPS</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Meeting Delivery Commitments</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Engagement and Relationship</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Partner adding value to Customer Business</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.NPS}</TableCell>

                      <TableCell>{row['Customer Engagement and Relationship']}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row['Partner adding value to Customer Business']}</TableCell>

          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}
      </ContentContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

const OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Date comparison function
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (dateStr1, dateStr2) => {
    if (!dateStr1 || !dateStr2) return false;
    
    const parseDate = (dateStr) => {
      // Handle MM-DD-YYYY format
      const parts = dateStr.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const [month, day, year] = parts;
        return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      }
      return new Date(dateStr);
    };

    const date1 = parseDate(dateStr1);
    const date2 = parseDate(dateStr2);
    
    return date1 >= date2;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      if (!excelData) {
        setError('No Excel data available');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('Processing Excel data for Org Level Qualitative Analysis...');
        console.log('Excel data:', excelData);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet (note: it has a trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT received Report ',  // With trailing space
            'CSAT received Report',  // Without trailing space
            'Sheet1', 
            'CSAT_Received_Report',
            'CSAT received Report'
          ];
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "CSAT received Report" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert sheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Get headers and data rows
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);

        console.log('Headers found:', headers);
        console.log('Data rows count:', dataRows.length);

        // Find required columns
        const businessUnitIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('unit')
          )
        );

        const customerIdIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('id')
          )
        );

        const customerNameIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && (
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer') && 
            header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('name')
          )
        );

        const perspectiveIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
        );

        const ratingDescriptionIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('rating') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('description')
        );

        const questionCategoryIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('question') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('category')
        );

        // Note: CSAT Sent Date and CSAT Received Date columns are not displayed but still used for filtering
        const csatSentDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('sent') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        const csatReceivedDateIndex = headers.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('received') && 
          header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          perspectiveIndex,
          ratingDescriptionIndex,
          questionCategoryIndex,
          csatSentDateIndex,
          csatReceivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (BUSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER NAME) not found');
        }

        if (perspectiveIndex === -1 || ratingDescriptionIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns (PERSPECTIVE, RATING_DESCRIPTION) not found');
        }

        // Define the specific perspectives we want to include
        const targetPerspectives = [
          'NPS',
          'Meeting Delivery Commitments',
          'Customer Engagement and Relationship',
          'Partner adding value to Customer Business'
        ];

        // Process data with date filtering and group by customer
        const rawFilteredData = dataRows
          .filter(row => {
            // Check if row has required data
            if (!row[businessUnitIndex] || !row[customerIdIndex] || !row[customerNameIndex]) {
              return false;
            }

            // Filter by specific perspectives
            const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
            if (!perspective || !targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
              return false;
            }

            // Apply date filtering if dates are available
            if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
              const sentDate = row[csatSentDateIndex];
              const receivedDate = row[csatReceivedDateIndex];
              
              // If we have sent date, check it
              if (sentDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
              
              // If we have received date, check it
              if (receivedDate && !isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted)) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            return true;
          });

        // Group data by customer
        const groupedData = {};
        rawFilteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const perspective = row[perspectiveIndex];
          const ratingDescription = row[ratingDescriptionIndex];

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: Object.keys(groupedData).length + 1,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              NPS: '',
              'Meeting Delivery Commitments': '',
              'Customer Engagement and Relationship': '',
              'Partner adding value to Customer Business': ''
            };
          }

          // Add rating description to the appropriate perspective column
          if (targetPerspectives.includes(perspective)) {
            groupedData[customerId][perspective] = ratingDescription || '';
          }
        });

        const filteredData = Object.values(groupedData);

        console.log('Filtered data count:', filteredData.length);
        console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData[0]);

        setProcessedData(filteredData);
        setFilteredData(filteredData);
        setLoading(false);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Filter data based on search term
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      setFilteredData(processedData);
    } else {
      const filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredData(filtered);
    }
  }, [searchTerm, processedData]);

  const exportToExcel = () => {
    if (filteredData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to export');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(filteredData);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Org Level Qualitative Analysis');
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, 'org_level_qualitative_analysis.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert('Error exporting data');
    }
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <StatusContainer>
          <div>Loading data...</div>
        </StatusContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <ErrorMessage>
          Error: {error}
        </ErrorMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <Title>📝 Org level/BU wise Qualitative Analysis</Title>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <ExportButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
            <Download size={20} />
            Export to Excel
          </ExportButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </Header>

      <ContentContainer>
        {processedData.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ padding: '1rem', borderBottom: '1px solid #e5e7eb' }}>
              <SuccessMessage>
                Found {processedData.length} customers matching the criteria
                {csatCycleStartDateFormatted && ` (filtered by CSAT cycle start date: ${csatCycleStartDateFormatted})`}
              </SuccessMessage>
            </div>
            
            <SearchContainer>
              <SearchInput
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by customer name..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              />
              <ClearButton onClick={clearSearch}>
                Clear
              </ClearButton>
            </SearchContainer>
            <TableContainer>
              <Table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <TableHeader>#</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Business Unit</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Name</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>NPS</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Meeting Delivery Commitments</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Customer Engagement and Relationship</TableHeader>
                    <TableHeader>Partner adding value to Customer Business</TableHeader>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredData.map((row) => (
                    <TableRow key={row.id}>
                      <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row.NPS}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row['Meeting Delivery Commitments']}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row['Customer Engagement and Relationship']}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{row['Partner adding value to Customer Business']}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </Table>
            </TableContainer>
          </>
        ) : (
          <StatusContainer>
            <div>No data found matching the criteria</div>
          </StatusContainer>
        )}

};

export default OrgLevelQualitativeAnalysisDashboard;
