```javascript
const LoadingMessage = styled.div`
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem;
  color: #6b7280;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
`;

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return false;
    
    try {
      // Parse the date string (assuming MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = dateString.split('-').map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
      const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name')
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date')
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns not found in the Excel file');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = sentDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = receivedDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent
          if (sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received
          if (receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 80) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 60) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Business Unit</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {processedData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
```

```javascript
  const [showNPSDashboard, setShowNPSDashboard] = useState(false);

  // ACSAT-specific CSAT date state
  const [acsatCycleStartDate, setAcsatCycleStartDate] = useState(null);
  const [acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, setAcsatCycleStartDateFormatted] = useState('');
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date and ACSAT cycle from context
  const { 
    csatCycleStartDate: pcsatCycleStartDate, 
    csatCycleStartDateFormatted: pcsatCycleStartDateFormatted, 
    updateCSATCycleStartDate,
    acsatCycle,
    updateAcsatCycle
  } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);

    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');

    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');

                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}

                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;
```

```javascript
  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);

    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);

        break;

        break;

        break;

        break;
      default:
```

```javascript
const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return false;
    
    try {
      // Parse the date string (assuming MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = dateString.split('-').map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
      const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name')
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date')
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        if (businessUnitIndex === -1 || customerIdIndex === -1 || customerNameIndex === -1) {
          throw new Error('Required columns not found in the Excel file');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = sentDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = receivedDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent
          if (sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received
          if (receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };

        ]);

      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
```

## ✅ **Sheet Name Issue Fixed!**

### **🔧 Problem Identified:**

The Excel file contains a sheet named **"CSAT sent and received Report "** (with a trailing space), but the code was looking for **"CSAT sent and received Report"** (without the trailing space).

```javascript
const alternativeNames = [
  'CSAT sent and received Report ',  // With trailing space (primary)
  'CSAT sent and received Report',   // Without trailing space (fallback)
  'Sheet2',
  'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
];
```

```javascript
const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return false;
    
    try {
      // Parse the date string (assuming MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = dateString.split('-').map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
      const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date')
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header =>

        );

        });

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = sentDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = receivedDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent
          if (sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received
          if (receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {

        cell.border = {

          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows

        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,

        ]);

        } else if (row.responseRate >= 60) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
```

```javascript
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem;

  font-size: 1.125rem;

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return false;
    
    try {
      // Parse the date string (assuming MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = dateString.split('-').map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
      const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date')
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Business Unit');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Customer ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Customer Name');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = sentDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = receivedDate ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent
          if (sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received
          if (receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 80) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 60) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Business Unit</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {processedData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
```

```javascript
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 80) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 60) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Business Unit</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {processedData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
```

```javascript
const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return false;
    
    try {
      // Parse the date string (assuming MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = dateString.split('-').map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
      const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date')
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date')
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Business Unit');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Customer ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('Customer Name');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 80) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 60) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      <TableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Business Unit</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {processedData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
```
