```javascript
`;

const FormulaText = styled.p`
  color: #6b7280;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
`;

const SearchContainer = styled.div`
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
`;

const SearchInput = styled.input`
  width: 200px;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  
  &:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #3b82f6;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
  }
`;

const ClearButton = styled.button`
  background: #ef4444;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  
  &:hover {
    background: #dc2626;
  }
`;

const SortableHeader = styled.th`
  padding: 1rem 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: 1px solid #374151;
  background: #1e3a8a;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  
  &:hover {
    background: #1e40af;
  }
`;

const SortIcon = styled.span`
  margin-left: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
`;

const GrandTotalRow = styled.tr`
  background: #f8fafc;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-top: 2px solid #3b82f6;
`;

const GrandTotalCell = styled.td`
  padding: 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #000000;
  background: #f8fafc;
`;

const GrandTotalResponseRateCell = styled.td`
  padding: 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: ${props => {
    if (props.rate >= 75) return '#059669'; // Dark Green >=75%
    if (props.rate >= 51) return '#d97706'; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
    return '#dc2626'; // Dark Red 0%-50%
  }};
`;

const LegendContainer = styled.div`
  background: white;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
`;

const LegendTitle = styled.h3`
  color: #374151;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;
`;

const LegendItem = styled.div`
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
`;

const LegendColor = styled.div`
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-right: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
`;

const LegendText = styled.span`
  color: #374151;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
`;

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Try multiple date formats
      let date;
      
      // Try MM-DD-YYYY format first
      if (dateString.includes('-') && dateString.split('-').length === 3) {
        const parts = dateString.split('-');
        if (parts[0].length <= 2 && parts[1].length <= 2 && parts[2].length === 4) {
          const [month, day, year] = parts.map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
          date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
        }
      }
      
      // Try other common formats
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        date = new Date(dateString);
      }
      
      // If still invalid, try parsing as Excel date number
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const excelDate = parseFloat(dateString);
        if (!isNaN(excelDate) && excelDate > 25569) { // Excel date > 1970-01-01
          date = new Date((excelDate - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
        }
      }
      
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        console.warn('Could not parse date:', dateString);
        return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
      }
      
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting
    if (sortConfig.key) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {sortedAndFilteredData.length} of {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
         <SearchInput
           type="text"
           placeholder="Search by account name..."
           value={searchTerm}
           onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
         />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;

```

```javascript
const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Try multiple date formats
      let date;
      
      // Try MM-DD-YYYY format first
      if (dateString.includes('-') && dateString.split('-').length === 3) {
        const parts = dateString.split('-');
        if (parts[0].length <= 2 && parts[1].length <= 2 && parts[2].length === 4) {
          const [month, day, year] = parts.map(num => parseInt(num, 10));
          date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
        }
      }
      
      // Try other common formats
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        date = new Date(dateString);
      }
      
      // If still invalid, try parsing as Excel date number
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const excelDate = parseFloat(dateString);
        if (!isNaN(excelDate) && excelDate > 25569) { // Excel date > 1970-01-01
          date = new Date((excelDate - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
        }
      }
      
      if (!date || isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        console.warn('Could not parse date:', dateString);
        return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
      }
      
      const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
      return date >= cycleDate;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        // Debug summary
        console.log('Data processing summary:', {
          totalRows: dataRows.length,
          uniqueCustomers: finalData.length,
          totalSurveysSent: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0),
          totalSurveysReceived: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0),
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex,
          csatCycleStartDateFormatted
        });

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting
    if (sortConfig.key) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {sortedAndFilteredData.length} of {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
         <SearchInput
           type="text"
           placeholder="Search by account name..."
           value={searchTerm}
           onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
         />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
```

## ✅ **Response Rate Dashboard Issues Fixed!**

### **🔧 Issues Fixed:**

**1. SNO Order After Sorting:**
- **Problem**: SNO numbers were not updating after sorting/filtering
- **Solution**: Added re-numbering logic in `sortedAndFilteredData` useMemo
- **Code**: `return filtered.map((row, index) => ({ ...row, id: index + 1 }));`

**2. Zero "Number of CSAT Surveys Sent":**
- **Problem**: Date filtering was too restrictive, causing all records to be filtered out
- **Solution**: Enhanced date parsing with multiple format support and fallback logic
- **Improvements**:
  - Added support for MM-DD-YYYY format
  - Added support for Excel date numbers
  - Added fallback to include records if date parsing fails
  - Changed default behavior to include records when no date filter is available

- Added detailed console logging for the first 3 rows to help diagnose data issues
- Added summary logging showing total counts and column indices
- This will help identify if the issue is with date parsing, column detection, or data format

```javascript

};
```

```javascript
const NPSDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [secondSheetData, setSecondSheetData] = useState([]);
  const [firstSheetData, setFirstSheetData] = useState([]);
  const [groupByBU, setGroupByBU] = useState(false);
  const [showScrollable, setShowScrollable] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  
  // Top 10 account names in order
  const top10AccountNames = [
    'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
    'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
    'Frontier Airlines INC',
    'Tufts Medicine',
    'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
    'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
    'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
    'BronxCare Health System',
    'Northern Trust Company',
    'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services JBFCS'
  ];
  
  // Get ACSAT cycle from global context
  const { acsatCycle } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart = (dateValue, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateValue || !cycleStartDate) {
      console.log('Missing date value or cycle start date:', { dateValue, cycleStartDate });
      return false;
    }
    
    try {
      // Parse the date value (could be string, number, or Date object)
      let dateToCheck;
      if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {
        // Clean the string
        const cleanDate = dateValue.toString().trim();
        
        // Try different date formats
        if (cleanDate.includes('/')) {
          // MM/DD/YYYY format
          const [month, day, year] = cleanDate.split('/');
          dateToCheck = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1, parseInt(day));
        } else if (cleanDate.includes('-')) {
          // Handle different dash-separated formats
          const parts = cleanDate.split('-');
          
          if (parts[0].length === 4) {
            // YYYY-MM-DD format
            dateToCheck = new Date(parseInt(parts[0]), parseInt(parts[1]) - 1, parseInt(parts[2]));
          } else if (parts.length === 3) {
            // Check if it's DD-MMM-YYYY format (like "28-Jul-2025")
            const monthNames = {
              'Jan': 0, 'Feb': 1, 'Mar': 2, 'Apr': 3, 'May': 4, 'Jun': 5,
              'Jul': 6, 'Aug': 7, 'Sep': 8, 'Oct': 9, 'Nov': 10, 'Dec': 11
            };
            
            if (parts[1] in monthNames) {
              // DD-MMM-YYYY format
              const day = parseInt(parts[0]);
              const month = monthNames[parts[1]];
              const year = parseInt(parts[2]);
              dateToCheck = new Date(year, month, day);
            } else if (parts[0].length === 2 && parts[1].length === 2) {
              // MM-DD-YYYY format
              dateToCheck = new Date(parseInt(parts[2]), parseInt(parts[0]) - 1, parseInt(parts[1]));
            } else {
              // Try parsing as regular date
              dateToCheck = new Date(cleanDate);
            }
          } else {
            // Try parsing as regular date
            dateToCheck = new Date(cleanDate);
          }
        } else {
          // Try parsing as regular date
          dateToCheck = new Date(cleanDate);
        }
      } else if (typeof dateValue === 'number') {
        // Excel serial date
        dateToCheck = new Date((dateValue - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
      } else {
        dateToCheck = new Date(dateValue);
      }
      
      // Parse cycle start date (MM-DD-YYYY format)
      const [month, day, year] = cycleStartDate.split('-');
      const cycleStart = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1, parseInt(day));
      
      // Validate MM-DD-YYYY format for cycle start date
      if (month.length !== 2 || day.length !== 2 || year.length !== 4) {
        console.error('Invalid cycle start date format. Expected MM-DD-YYYY, got:', cycleStartDate);
        return false;
      }
      
      // Check if date is valid
      if (isNaN(dateToCheck.getTime()) || isNaN(cycleStart.getTime())) {
        console.log('Invalid date:', { 
          originalValue: dateValue, 
          parsedDate: dateToCheck, 
          cycleStartDate: cycleStartDate,
          parsedCycleStart: cycleStart 
        });
        return false;
      }
      
      const result = dateToCheck >= cycleStart;
      
      // Enhanced logging for debugging
      console.log('Date comparison:', {
        originalValue: dateValue,
        parsedDate: isNaN(dateToCheck.getTime()) ? 'Invalid Date' : dateToCheck.toDateString(),
        cycleStartDate: cycleStartDate,
        parsedCycleStart: cycleStart.toDateString(),
        result: result,
        timeDiff: isNaN(dateToCheck.getTime()) ? 'N/A' : (dateToCheck.getTime() - cycleStart.getTime())
      });
      
      // Additional debugging for date parsing issues
      if (isNaN(dateToCheck.getTime())) {
        console.error('Date parsing failed for:', {
          originalValue: dateValue,
          cleanDate: dateValue.toString().trim(),
          type: typeof dateValue,
          parts: dateValue.toString().trim().split('-')
        });
      }
      
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', { dateValue, cycleStartDate, error });
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Load first sheet data (CSAT received Report) for NPS ratings
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!excelData) return;

    try {
      console.log('Loading NPS ratings from first sheet...');
      console.log('Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      
      // Find the first sheet (CSAT received Report)
      const firstSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('received') && name.toLowerCase().includes('report')
      );
      
      if (firstSheetName) {
        console.log('Found first sheet:', firstSheetName);
        const worksheet = excelData.Sheets[firstSheetName];
        
        // Find header row
        let headerRow = 1;
        const range = XLSX.utils.decode_range(worksheet['!ref']);
        
        for (let row = 1; row <= range.e.r; row++) {
          const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: row, c: 0 });
          const cell = worksheet[cellAddress];
          if (cell && cell.v && typeof cell.v === 'string') {
            if (cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('customer') || 
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('rating') ||
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('perspective')) {
              headerRow = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        console.log('First sheet header row found at:', headerRow);
        
        // Convert to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { 
          header: 1,
          range: headerRow - 1
        });
        
        if (jsonData.length > 0) {
          const headers = jsonData[0];
          const processedData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
            const obj = {};
            headers.forEach((header, index) => {
              obj[header] = row[index];
            });
            return obj;
          });
          
          console.log('Processed first sheet data:', processedData.length, 'rows');
          console.log('Sample data:', processedData[0]);
          console.log('Available columns:', Object.keys(processedData[0] || {}));
          
          // Filter by YEAR - QUARTER if acsatCycle is provided
          const filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            if (acsatCycle && (row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER'])) {
              return (row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER']) === acsatCycle;
            }
            return true; // Include all rows if no acsatCycle specified
          });
          
          setFirstSheetData(filteredData);
          
          // Debug: Log filtering results for first sheet
          console.log('NPSDashboard - First sheet data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
          console.log('ACSAT Cycle for filtering:', acsatCycle);
          console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData.slice(0, 3));
          if (filteredData.length > 0) {
            console.log('Available columns in first sheet:', Object.keys(filteredData[0]));
            console.log('YEAR - QUARTER values in filtered data:', [...new Set(filteredData.map(row => row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER'] || row['Year Quarter']))]);
          }
        } else {
          console.log('No data found in first sheet');
        }
      } else {
        console.log('First sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading first sheet data:', error);
    }
  }, [excelData, acsatCycle]);

  // Load second sheet data
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!excelData) return;

    try {
      console.log('Loading NPS data from second sheet...');
      console.log('Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      
      // Find the second sheet
      const secondSheetName = excelData.SheetNames.find(name => 
        name.toLowerCase().includes('sent') && name.toLowerCase().includes('received')
      );
      
      if (secondSheetName) {
        console.log('Found second sheet:', secondSheetName);
        const worksheet = excelData.Sheets[secondSheetName];
        
        // Find header row
        let headerRow = 1;
        const range = XLSX.utils.decode_range(worksheet['!ref']);
        
        for (let row = 1; row <= range.e.r; row++) {
          const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ r: row, c: 0 });
          const cell = worksheet[cellAddress];
          if (cell && cell.v && typeof cell.v === 'string') {
            if (cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('customer') || 
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('css_sent') ||
                cell.v.toLowerCase().includes('css_received')) {
              headerRow = row;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        
        console.log('Header row found at:', headerRow);
        
        // Convert to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { 
          header: 1,
          range: headerRow - 1
        });
        
        if (jsonData.length > 0) {
          const headers = jsonData[0];
          const processedData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
            const obj = {};
            headers.forEach((header, index) => {
              obj[header] = row[index];
            });
            return obj;
          });
          
          console.log('Processed second sheet data:', processedData.length, 'rows');
          console.log('Sample data:', processedData[0]);
          console.log('Available columns:', Object.keys(processedData[0] || {}));
          
          // Filter by YEAR - QUARTER if acsatCycle is provided
          const filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            if (acsatCycle && (row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER'])) {
              return (row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER']) === acsatCycle;
            }
            return true; // Include all rows if no acsatCycle specified
          });
          
          setSecondSheetData(filteredData);
          
          // Debug: Log filtering results for second sheet
          console.log('NPSDashboard - Second sheet data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
          console.log('ACSAT Cycle for filtering:', acsatCycle);
          console.log('Sample filtered data:', filteredData.slice(0, 3));
          if (filteredData.length > 0) {
            console.log('Available columns in second sheet:', Object.keys(filteredData[0]));
            console.log('YEAR - QUARTER values in filtered data:', [...new Set(filteredData.map(row => row['YEAR - QUARTER'] || row['YEAR_QUARTER'] || row['Year Quarter']))]);
          }
        } else {
          console.log('No data found in second sheet');
        }
      } else {
        console.log('Second sheet not found. Available sheets:', excelData.SheetNames);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading NPS data:', error);
    }
  }, [excelData, acsatCycle]);

  // Process data for display
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!secondSheetData || secondSheetData.length === 0) {
      console.log('No second sheet data available');
      return { data: [], summary: { top5Accounts: [], achievedNPSScore: 0, responseRate: 0, totalSent: 0, totalReceived: 0 } };
    }

    console.log('Processing NPS data...');
    console.log('Second sheet data length:', secondSheetData.length);
    console.log('First sheet data length:', firstSheetData.length);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', acsatCycleStartDateFormatted);
    
    if (acsatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
      console.log('📅 Date Filtering Configuration:');
      console.log('  - CSAT Cycle Start Date (MM-DD-YYYY):', acsatCycleStartDateFormatted);
      console.log('  - CSS SENT DATE: Only dates >= cycle start date will be counted');
      console.log('  - CSS RECEIVED DATE: Only dates >= cycle start date will be counted');
      console.log('  - NPS Ratings: Only from surveys sent >= cycle start date will be processed');
    } else {
      console.log('⚠️ No CSAT cycle start date provided - processing all data without date filtering');
    }

    try {
      // Group data by Business Unit or Customer
      const groupedData = {};
      
      secondSheetData.forEach(row => {
        const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];
        const businessUnit = row['BUSINESS UNIT'] || row['Business Unit'] || 'Unknown';
        
        // Extract customer name from second sheet as well
        let customerName = '';
        const possibleCustomerNameKeys = [
          'CUSTOMER NAME', 'CUSTOMER_NAME', 'Customer Name', 'CUST_NM', 'CUST_NAME',
          'CUSTOMER_NM', 'Customer_Name', 'CUSTOMER', 'Customer', 'CUST_NAME',
          'CLIENT NAME', 'CLIENT_NAME', 'Client Name', 'CLIENT_NM'
        ];
        
        for (const key of possibleCustomerNameKeys) {
          if (row[key] && row[key].toString().trim() !== '') {
            customerName = row[key].toString().trim();
            break;
          }
        }
        
        // If still no customer name found, try to find it in other possible columns
        if (!customerName) {
          const possibleCustomerColumns = Object.keys(row).filter(key => 
            key && key.toString().trim() !== '' && (
              (key.toLowerCase().includes('customer') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
              (key.toLowerCase().includes('cust') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
              (key.toLowerCase().includes('client') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name'))
            ) && !key.toLowerCase().includes('respondent')
          );
          
          if (possibleCustomerColumns.length > 0) {
            for (const col of possibleCustomerColumns) {
              if (row[col] && row[col].toString().trim() !== '') {
                customerName = row[col].toString().trim();
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        
        // If still no customer name, use customer ID as fallback
        if (!customerName && customerId) {
          customerName = customerId.toString();
        }
        
        // Debug customer name extraction from second sheet
        if (Object.keys(groupedData).length < 5) {
          console.log(`Second sheet row - Customer name extraction:`, {
            'customerId': customerId,
            'extractedName': customerName,
            'availableKeys': Object.keys(row).slice(0, 10),
            'possibleCustomerColumns': Object.keys(row).filter(key => 
              key && key.toString().trim() !== '' && (
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('customer') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('cust') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('client') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name'))
              ) && !key.toLowerCase().includes('respondent')
            )
          });
        }
        
        // Debug business unit extraction
        if (!businessUnit || businessUnit === 'Unknown') {
          console.log('🔍 Business Unit Debug:');
          console.log('  Row keys:', Object.keys(row));
          console.log('  BUSINESS UNIT value:', row['BUSINESS UNIT']);
          console.log('  Business Unit value:', row['Business Unit']);
          console.log('  Final businessUnit:', businessUnit);
        }
        
        if (!customerId) return;
        
        const key = groupByBU ? businessUnit : customerId;
        
        if (!groupedData[key]) {
          groupedData[key] = {
            businessUnit: businessUnit,
            customerId: customerId,
            customerName: customerName || 'Unknown', // Use extracted customer name or 'Unknown'
            sentCount: 0,
            receivedCount: 0,
            promotersCount: 0,
            detractorsCount: 0,
            predictedPromotersCount: 0,
            predictedDetractorsCount: 0,
            predictedNeutralCount: 0
          };
        }
        
        // Count CSS SENT DATE with date filtering
        const sentDate = row['CSS SENT DATE'] || row['CSS_SENT_DATE'];
        if (sentDate && sentDate.toString().trim() !== '') {
          const isSentDateValid = isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(sentDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted);
          
          if (isSentDateValid) {
            groupedData[key].sentCount++;
            console.log('✅ CSS SENT DATE included:', sentDate, 'for customer:', customerId);
          } else {
            console.log('❌ CSS SENT DATE filtered out:', sentDate, 'for customer:', customerId, '(before cycle start date)');
          }
        }
        
        // Count CSS RECEIVED DATE with date filtering
        const receivedDate = row['CSS RECEIVED DATE'] || row['CSS_RECEIVED_DATE'];
        if (receivedDate && receivedDate.toString().trim() !== '') {
          const isReceivedDateValid = isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(receivedDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted);
          
          if (isReceivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[key].receivedCount++;
            console.log('✅ CSS RECEIVED DATE included:', receivedDate, 'for customer:', customerId);
          } else {
            console.log('❌ CSS RECEIVED DATE filtered out:', receivedDate, 'for customer:', customerId, '(before cycle start date)');
          }
        }
      });

      // Process NPS ratings from first sheet
      if (firstSheetData && firstSheetData.length > 0) {
        console.log('Processing NPS ratings from first sheet...');
        console.log('First sheet sample data:', firstSheetData[0]);
        console.log('Available columns in first sheet:', Object.keys(firstSheetData[0] || {}));
        
        // First, let's find all customers with NPS data
        const customersWithNPSData = new Set();
        const npsRecordsByCustomer = {};
        
        firstSheetData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];
          
          // Debug: Log first few rows
          if (index < 3) {
            console.log(`Processing first sheet row ${index + 1}:`, {
              customerId,
              availableKeys: Object.keys(row).slice(0, 10)
            });
          }
          
          // Comprehensive customer name extraction
          let customerName = '';
          
          // Try multiple possible column names for customer name
          const possibleCustomerNameKeys = [
            'CUSTOMER NAME', 'CUSTOMER_NAME', 'Customer Name', 'CUST_NM', 'CUST_NAME',
            'CUSTOMER_NM', 'Customer_Name', 'CUSTOMER', 'Customer', 'CUST_NAME',
            'CLIENT NAME', 'CLIENT_NAME', 'Client Name', 'CLIENT_NM'
          ];
          
          for (const key of possibleCustomerNameKeys) {
            if (row[key] && row[key].toString().trim() !== '') {
              customerName = row[key].toString().trim();
              break;
            }
          }
          
          // If still no customer name found, try to find it in other possible columns
          if (!customerName) {
            const possibleCustomerColumns = Object.keys(row).filter(key => 
              key && key.toString().trim() !== '' && (
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('customer') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('cust') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                (key.toLowerCase().includes('client') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name'))
              ) && !key.toLowerCase().includes('respondent')
            );
            
            if (possibleCustomerColumns.length > 0) {
              for (const col of possibleCustomerColumns) {
                if (row[col] && row[col].toString().trim() !== '') {
                  customerName = row[col].toString().trim();
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
          }
          
          // If still no customer name, use customer ID as fallback
          if (!customerName && customerId) {
            customerName = customerId.toString();
          }
          
          const perspective = row['PERSPECTIVE'] || row['Perspective'] || '';
          const rating = row['RATING'] || row['Rating'];
          
          // Debug customer name extraction for first few rows
          if (index < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${index + 1} - Customer Name extraction:`, {
              'CUSTOMER NAME': row['CUSTOMER NAME'],
              'CUST_NM': row['CUST_NM'],
              'CUSTOMER_NAME': row['CUSTOMER_NAME'],
              'Customer Name': row['Customer Name'],
              'RESPONDENT NAME': row['RESPONDENT NAME'],
              'RESPONDENT_NAME': row['RESPONDENT_NAME'],
              'extractedName': customerName,
              'customerId': customerId,
              'allKeys': Object.keys(row).slice(0, 15),
              'possibleCustomerColumns': Object.keys(row).filter(key => 
                key && key.toString().trim() !== '' && (
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('customer') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('cust') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('client') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name'))
                ) && !key.toLowerCase().includes('respondent')
              )
            });
          }
          
          // Debug customer name extraction for rows around index 7
          if (index >= 6 && index <= 8) {
            console.log(`Row ${index + 1} - Customer Name extraction (around S.No 7):`, {
              'CUSTOMER NAME': row['CUSTOMER NAME'],
              'CUST_NM': row['CUST_NM'],
              'CUSTOMER_NAME': row['CUSTOMER_NAME'],
              'Customer Name': row['Customer Name'],
              'RESPONDENT NAME': row['RESPONDENT NAME'],
              'RESPONDENT_NAME': row['RESPONDENT_NAME'],
              'extractedName': customerName,
              'customerId': customerId,
              'allKeys': Object.keys(row).slice(0, 15),
              'possibleCustomerColumns': Object.keys(row).filter(key => 
                key && key.toString().trim() !== '' && (
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('customer') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('cust') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name')) ||
                  (key.toLowerCase().includes('client') && key.toLowerCase().includes('name'))
                ) && !key.toLowerCase().includes('respondent')
              )
            });
          }
          
          if (customerId && perspective && rating !== undefined && rating !== null) {
            if (perspective.toString().toLowerCase().includes('nps')) {
              customersWithNPSData.add(customerId);
              if (!npsRecordsByCustomer[customerId]) {
                npsRecordsByCustomer[customerId] = [];
              }
              npsRecordsByCustomer[customerId].push({
                customerName,
                perspective,
                rating,
                row
              });
            }
          }
        });
        
        console.log('Customers with NPS data:', Array.from(customersWithNPSData));
        console.log('Northern Trust NPS records:', npsRecordsByCustomer[Object.keys(npsRecordsByCustomer).find(key => 
          npsRecordsByCustomer[key].some(record => 
            record.customerName.toLowerCase().includes('northern trust')
          )
        )]);
        
        // Now process each customer with NPS data
        Object.keys(npsRecordsByCustomer).forEach(customerId => {
          const npsRecords = npsRecordsByCustomer[customerId];
          const firstRecord = npsRecords[0];
          const customerName = firstRecord.customerName;
          const businessUnit = firstRecord.row['BUSINESS UNIT'] || firstRecord.row['Business Unit'] || 'Unknown';
          
          // Debug for Northern Trust Company
          if (customerName.toLowerCase().includes('northern trust')) {
            console.log('🔍 Processing Northern Trust Company NPS Records:');
            console.log('  Customer ID:', customerId);
            console.log('  Customer Name:', customerName);
            console.log('  Business Unit:', businessUnit);
            console.log('  NPS Records Count:', npsRecords.length);
            console.log('  Sample NPS Record:', firstRecord);
          }
          
          // Try to find existing group by customer name if ID doesn't match
          let key = groupByBU ? businessUnit : customerId;
          let existingGroup = groupedData[key];
          
          // If no group found by ID, try to find by customer name
          if (!existingGroup && !groupByBU) {
            const matchingKey = Object.keys(groupedData).find(k => {
              const group = groupedData[k];
              return group.customerName && group.customerName.toLowerCase() === customerName.toLowerCase();
            });
            
            if (matchingKey) {
              key = matchingKey;
              existingGroup = groupedData[key];
              console.log('Found existing group by name for:', customerName, 'using key:', key);
            }
          }
          
          // Create group if it doesn't exist
          if (!existingGroup) {
            console.log('Creating new group for customer:', customerName, 'with key:', key);
            groupedData[key] = {
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              sentCount: 0,
              receivedCount: 0,
              promotersCount: 0,
              detractorsCount: 0
            };
          } else {
            // Update customer name from first sheet data if it's currently 'Unknown' or empty
            if (existingGroup.customerName === 'Unknown' || !existingGroup.customerName || existingGroup.customerName === '') {
              existingGroup.customerName = customerName;
```
