            console.log('Final fallback: Set customer name to customer ID:', group.customerId, 'for group:', group);
          } else {
            group.customerName = 'Unknown Customer';
            console.log('Final fallback: Set customer name to Unknown Customer for group:', group);
          }
        }
      });

      // Convert to array and calculate response rate and NPS score
      let result = Object.values(groupedData).map(group => {
        const responseRate = group.sentCount > 0 ? (group.receivedCount / group.sentCount) * 100 : 0;
        const npsScore = group.receivedCount > 0 ? ((group.promotersCount - group.detractorsCount) / group.receivedCount) * 100 : 0;
        // Calculate predicted NPS as (% Promoters - % Detractors)
        const totalPredictedRecords = group.predictedPromotersCount + group.predictedDetractorsCount + (group.predictedNeutralCount || 0);
        const predictedPromotersPercent = totalPredictedRecords > 0 ? (group.predictedPromotersCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100 : 0;
        const predictedDetractorsPercent = totalPredictedRecords > 0 ? (group.predictedDetractorsCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100 : 0;
        const predictedNpsScore = predictedPromotersPercent - predictedDetractorsPercent;
        
        return {
          ...group,
          responseRate: responseRate,
          npsScore: npsScore,
          predictedNpsScore: predictedNpsScore
        };
      });
      
      // Debug: Log all business units found
      console.log('🔍 NPS Dashboard Business Units Found:');
      const uniqueBusinessUnits = [...new Set(result.map(item => item.businessUnit))];
      console.log('  Unique Business Units:', uniqueBusinessUnits);
      console.log('  Total records:', result.length);
      console.log('  Sample records:', result.slice(0, 3));

      // Filter out rows where Number of CSAT Surveys Sent = 0
      result = result.filter(group => group.sentCount > 0);

      // Apply search filter for customer name (only when not grouping by BU)
      if (!groupByBU && searchTerm.trim()) {
        result = result.filter(group => {
          const customerName = (group.customerName || '').toLowerCase();
          const customerId = (group.customerId || '').toLowerCase();
          const searchLower = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
          return customerName.includes(searchLower) || customerId.includes(searchLower);
        });
      }

      // Sort by response rate (descending)
      result.sort((a, b) => b.responseRate - a.responseRate);

      // Calculate grand total
      let grandTotal = null;
      if (result.length > 0) {
        grandTotal = {
          businessUnit: 'GRAND TOTAL',
          customerId: '',
          customerName: '',
          sentCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.sentCount || 0), 0),
          receivedCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.receivedCount || 0), 0),
          promotersCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.promotersCount || 0), 0),
          detractorsCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.detractorsCount || 0), 0),
          predictedPromotersCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.predictedPromotersCount || 0), 0),
          predictedDetractorsCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.predictedDetractorsCount || 0), 0),
          predictedNeutralCount: result.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.predictedNeutralCount || 0), 0),
          responseRate: 0, // Will be calculated below
          npsScore: 0, // Will be calculated below
          predictedNpsScore: 0, // Will be calculated below
          isGrandTotal: true
        };

        // Calculate grand total response rate
        if (grandTotal.sentCount > 0) {
          grandTotal.responseRate = (grandTotal.receivedCount / grandTotal.sentCount) * 100;
        }

        // Calculate grand total NPS score
        if (grandTotal.receivedCount > 0) {
          const totalPromoters = grandTotal.promotersCount;
          const totalDetractors = grandTotal.detractorsCount;
          grandTotal.npsScore = ((totalPromoters - totalDetractors) / grandTotal.receivedCount) * 100;
        }

        // Calculate grand total predicted NPS score using percentage formula
        const totalPredictedRecords = grandTotal.predictedPromotersCount + grandTotal.predictedDetractorsCount + grandTotal.predictedNeutralCount;
        if (totalPredictedRecords > 0) {
          const predictedPromotersPercent = (grandTotal.predictedPromotersCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100;
          const predictedDetractorsPercent = (grandTotal.predictedDetractorsCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100;
          grandTotal.predictedNpsScore = predictedPromotersPercent - predictedDetractorsPercent;
        }

        // Add grand total to result
        result.push(grandTotal);
      }

      // Calculate summary data
      const summaryData = {
        top5Accounts: [],
        achievedNPSScore: 0,
        responseRate: 0,
        totalSent: 0,
        totalReceived: 0
      };

      // Get top 5 accounts with highest NPS scores (only for account-wise data)
      if (!groupByBU && result.length > 0) {
        const nonGrandTotalData = result.filter(group => !group.isGrandTotal);
        const sortedByNPS = [...nonGrandTotalData].sort((a, b) => b.npsScore - a.npsScore);
        summaryData.top5Accounts = sortedByNPS.slice(0, 5).map((group, index) => ({
          rank: index + 1,
          customerName: group.customerName || group.customerId || 'Unknown',
          npsScore: Math.round(group.npsScore * 100) / 100
        }));
      }

      // Get achieved NPS score and response rate from grand total
      if (grandTotal) {
        summaryData.achievedNPSScore = Math.round(grandTotal.npsScore * 100) / 100;
        summaryData.responseRate = grandTotal.responseRate;
        summaryData.totalSent = grandTotal.sentCount;
        summaryData.totalReceived = grandTotal.receivedCount;
      }

      console.log('Processed NPS data:', result.length, 'groups');
      console.log('Sample processed data:', result[0]);
      console.log('Grand total:', grandTotal);
      console.log('Summary data:', summaryData);

      // Filter for Top 10 accounts if showTop10 is true
      let finalResult = result;
      if (showTop10) {
        console.log('Filtering for Top 10 accounts:', top10AccountNames);
        
        // Separate grand total row from regular data
        const grandTotalRow = result.find(row => row.isGrandTotal);
        const regularData = result.filter(row => !row.isGrandTotal);
        
        // Filter regular data by predefined account names
        const filteredRegularData = regularData.filter(row => {
          const customerName = row.customerName || '';
          return top10AccountNames.some(top10Name => 
            customerName.toLowerCase().includes(top10Name.toLowerCase()) ||
            top10Name.toLowerCase().includes(customerName.toLowerCase())
          );
        });
        
        // Sort by the predefined order
        filteredRegularData.sort((a, b) => {
          const aIndex = top10AccountNames.findIndex(name => 
            (a.customerName || '').toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase()) ||
            name.toLowerCase().includes((a.customerName || '').toLowerCase())
          );
          const bIndex = top10AccountNames.findIndex(name => 
            (b.customerName || '').toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase()) ||
            name.toLowerCase().includes((b.customerName || '').toLowerCase())
          );
          return aIndex - bIndex;
        });
        
        // Recalculate grand total for Top 10 data
        let top10GrandTotal = null;
        if (filteredRegularData.length > 0) {
          top10GrandTotal = {
            businessUnit: 'TOTAL',
            customerName: 'TOTAL',
            sentCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.sentCount || 0), 0),
            receivedCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.receivedCount || 0), 0),
            promotersCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.promotersCount || 0), 0),
            detractorsCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.detractorsCount || 0), 0),
            predictedPromotersCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.predictedPromotersCount || 0), 0),
            predictedDetractorsCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.predictedDetractorsCount || 0), 0),
            predictedNeutralCount: filteredRegularData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.predictedNeutralCount || 0), 0),
            isGrandTotal: true
          };
          
          // Calculate response rate
          if (top10GrandTotal.sentCount > 0) {
            top10GrandTotal.responseRate = (top10GrandTotal.receivedCount / top10GrandTotal.sentCount) * 100;
          }
          
          // Calculate NPS score
          if (top10GrandTotal.receivedCount > 0) {
            const totalPromoters = top10GrandTotal.promotersCount;
            const totalDetractors = top10GrandTotal.detractorsCount;
            top10GrandTotal.npsScore = ((totalPromoters - totalDetractors) / top10GrandTotal.receivedCount) * 100;
          }
          
          // Calculate predicted NPS score
          const totalPredictedRecords = top10GrandTotal.predictedPromotersCount + top10GrandTotal.predictedDetractorsCount + top10GrandTotal.predictedNeutralCount;
          if (totalPredictedRecords > 0) {
            const predictedPromotersPercent = (top10GrandTotal.predictedPromotersCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100;
            const predictedDetractorsPercent = (top10GrandTotal.predictedDetractorsCount / totalPredictedRecords) * 100;
            top10GrandTotal.predictedNpsScore = predictedPromotersPercent - predictedDetractorsPercent;
          }
        }
        
        // Combine filtered data with grand total
        finalResult = [...filteredRegularData];
        if (top10GrandTotal) {
          finalResult.push(top10GrandTotal);
        }
        
        console.log('Top 10 filtered data:', finalResult);
      }

      return { data: finalResult, summary: summaryData };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing NPS data:', error);
      console.error('Error stack:', error.stack);
      console.error('Error details:', {
        message: error.message,
        name: error.name,
        secondSheetDataLength: secondSheetData?.length,
        firstSheetDataLength: firstSheetData?.length,
        groupByBU,
        acsatCycleStartDateFormatted
      });
      return { data: [], summary: { top5Accounts: [], achievedNPSScore: 0, responseRate: 0, totalSent: 0, totalReceived: 0 } };
    }
  }, [secondSheetData, firstSheetData, groupByBU, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, searchTerm, showTop10]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort data based on sort configuration
  const sortedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData?.data) return [];
    if (!sortConfig.key) return processedData.data;
    
    const sorted = [...processedData.data].sort((a, b) => {
      let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
      let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
      
      if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit') {
        aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
      }
      
      if (aValue < bValue) {
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (aValue > bValue) {
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      }
      return 0;
    });
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting (but preserve grand total at the end)
    const grandTotalIndex = sorted.findIndex(item => item.isGrandTotal);
    if (grandTotalIndex !== -1) {
      const grandTotal = sorted.splice(grandTotalIndex, 1)[0];
      const regularData = sorted.map((item, index) => ({
        ...item,
        displayIndex: index + 1
      }));
      return [...regularData, grandTotal];
    }
    
    return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      displayIndex: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData?.data, sortConfig]);

  // Download Excel
  const downloadExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('NPS Dashboard');

      // Helper function to get NPS color
      const getNPSColor = (score) => {
        if (score >= 75) return { bg: 'FF28A745', fg: 'FFFFFFFF' }; // Dark Green >=75%
        if (score >= 31) return { bg: 'FFFFC107', fg: 'FFFFFFFF' }; // Dark Amber 31%-74%
        return { bg: 'FFDC3545', fg: 'FFFFFFFF' }; // Dark Red 0%-30%
      };

      // Add grouped headers with proper colSpan
      const baseHeaders = groupByBU
        ? ['S.No', 'Business Unit', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Received']
        : ['S.No', 'Business Unit', 'Account Name', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Received'];

      const subHeaders = groupByBU
        ? ['', '', '', '', 'Number of Promoters', 'Number of Detractors', 'NPS', 'Number of Promoters', 'Number of Detractors', 'NPS']
        : ['', '', '', '', '', 'Number of Promoters', 'Number of Detractors', 'NPS', 'Number of Promoters', 'Number of Detractors', 'NPS'];

      // Add first row with individual headers and grouped headers
      const firstRow = worksheet.addRow([...baseHeaders, 'Predicted NPS for the surveys received', '', '', 'Actual NPS', '', '']);
      
      // Style the first row
      firstRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        const headerValue = cell.value;
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: headerValue === 'Predicted NPS for the surveys received' ? 'FF000000' : 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        
        // Style based on header type
        if (headerValue === 'Predicted NPS for the surveys received') {
          cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFE0' } };
        } else if (headerValue === 'Actual NPS') {
          cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFE0' } };
        } else {
          cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        }
        
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } }
        };
      });

      // Merge cells for grouped headers
      const predictedStartCol = groupByBU ? 5 : 6; // Column E for BU-wise, F for account-wise
      const predictedEndCol = predictedStartCol + 2; // 3 columns for Predicted NPS
      const actualStartCol = predictedEndCol + 1; // Next column after Predicted NPS
      const actualEndCol = actualStartCol + 2; // 3 columns for Actual NPS

      // Merge Predicted NPS header
      worksheet.mergeCells(1, predictedStartCol, 1, predictedEndCol);
      // Merge Actual NPS header  
      worksheet.mergeCells(1, actualStartCol, 1, actualEndCol);
      
      // Ensure the merged cells have the correct text
      const predictedCell = worksheet.getCell(1, predictedStartCol);
      predictedCell.value = 'Predicted NPS for the surveys received';
      predictedCell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
      predictedCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFE0' } };
      predictedCell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      
      const actualCell = worksheet.getCell(1, actualStartCol);
      actualCell.value = 'Actual NPS';
      actualCell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
      actualCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFE0' } };
      actualCell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };

      // Add second row with sub-headers
      const secondRow = worksheet.addRow(subHeaders);
      secondRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        const headerValue = cell.value;
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        
        // Style based on header type - use dark blue for main headers and specific NPS sub-headers
        if (headerValue === 'Number of Promoters' || headerValue === 'Number of Detractors' || headerValue === 'NPS') {
          // These specific sub-headers should use dark blue
          cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        } else {
          // Main headers - use dark blue
          cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        }
        
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } }
        };
      });
      
      // Set header row heights for better text wrapping
      firstRow.height = 40;
      secondRow.height = 40;

      // Add data rows
      sortedData.forEach((group, index) => {
        const rowData = groupByBU
          ? [
              group.isGrandTotal ? 'TOTAL' : (group.displayIndex || index + 1),
              group.businessUnit,
              group.sentCount,
              group.receivedCount,
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.predictedPromotersCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.predictedDetractorsCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : Math.round((group.predictedNpsScore || 0) * 100) / 100,
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.promotersCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.detractorsCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : Math.round((group.npsScore || 0) * 100) / 100
            ]
          : [
              group.isGrandTotal ? 'TOTAL' : (group.displayIndex || index + 1),
              group.businessUnit,
              group.customerName,
              group.sentCount,
              group.receivedCount,
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.predictedPromotersCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.predictedDetractorsCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : Math.round((group.predictedNpsScore || 0) * 100) / 100,
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.promotersCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : (group.detractorsCount || 0),
              group.receivedCount === 0 ? '-' : Math.round((group.npsScore || 0) * 100) / 100
            ];

        const row = worksheet.addRow(rowData);
        
        // Apply word wrapping to all cells in the data row
        row.eachCell((cell) => {
          cell.alignment = {
            horizontal: 'center',
            vertical: 'middle',
            wrapText: true // Enable word wrapping for all data cells
          };
        });
        
        // Set row height for better text wrapping
        row.height = 30;
        
        // Style grand total row
        if (group.isGrandTotal) {
          row.eachCell((cell) => {
            cell.font = { bold: true };
            cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
            cell.border = {
              top: { style: 'medium', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
              left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
              bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } },
              right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } }
            };
          });
        }
        
        // Style NPS cells based on score
        const npsScore = group.npsScore || 0;
        const predictedNpsScore = group.predictedNpsScore || 0;
        
        // Style Actual NPS cell (last column for account-wise, second to last for BU-wise)
        const actualNpsCellIndex = groupByBU ? 10 : 11; // Adjust based on column position
        const actualNpsCell = row.getCell(actualNpsCellIndex);
        if (npsScore >= 75) {
          actualNpsCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF28A745' } }; // Dark Green
        } else if (npsScore > 0) {
          actualNpsCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFFFC107' } }; // Dark Amber
        } else {
          actualNpsCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC3545' } }; // Dark Red
        }
        actualNpsCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        // Style Predicted NPS cell (3rd column for account-wise, 2nd for BU-wise)
        const predictedNpsCellIndex = groupByBU ? 7 : 8; // Adjust based on column position
        const predictedNpsCell = row.getCell(predictedNpsCellIndex);
        if (predictedNpsScore >= 75) {
          predictedNpsCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF28A745' } }; // Dark Green
        } else if (predictedNpsScore > 0) {

        } else {

        }
        predictedNpsCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

        // Apply borders to all cells

            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF000000' } }
          };
        });
      });

      // Add NPS Calculation Formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedData.length + 3;

      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF7FAFC' } };

      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF4A5568' } };
      
      // Add breakdown
      worksheet.addRow(['Where:']);

      worksheet.addRow(['• Detractors: Customers who gave ratings less than 7']);

      // Add legend
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 6;

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: ≥75% (On Track)']);
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 0% to 75% (Manageable)']);
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <0% (Needs Attention)']);

      // Add NPS Dashboard Summary section
      worksheet.addRow([]);
      worksheet.addRow([]);
      
      // Record the start row for the summary section
      const summaryStartRow = worksheet.lastRow.number + 1;
      
      // NPS Dashboard Summary Title
      const summaryTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['📊 NPS Dashboard Summary']);
      const summaryTitleRowNum = summaryTitleRow.number;
      summaryTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 16, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
      summaryTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1D4ED8' } };
      summaryTitleRow.getCell(1).alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
      summaryTitleRow.height = 45;
      worksheet.mergeCells(`A${summaryTitleRowNum}:F${summaryTitleRowNum}`);

      // Add Achieved NPS Score
      worksheet.addRow([]);
      const achievedNPSTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['🎯 Achieved NPS Score']);
      const achievedNPSTitleRowNum = achievedNPSTitleRow.number;
      achievedNPSTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14, color: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      achievedNPSTitleRow.getCell(1).alignment = { horizontal: 'left', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
      achievedNPSTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF0FDF4' } };
      achievedNPSTitleRow.height = 35;
      worksheet.mergeCells(`A${achievedNPSTitleRowNum}:F${achievedNPSTitleRowNum}`);
      
      const achievedNPSValueRow = worksheet.addRow([`${processedData.summary?.achievedNPSScore || 0}`]);
      const achievedNPSValueRowNum = achievedNPSValueRow.number;
      achievedNPSValueRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14, color: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      achievedNPSValueRow.getCell(1).alignment = { horizontal: 'left', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
      achievedNPSValueRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF9FAFB' } };
      achievedNPSValueRow.height = 30;
      worksheet.mergeCells(`A${achievedNPSValueRowNum}:F${achievedNPSValueRowNum}`);
      
      const achievedNPSDescRow = worksheet.addRow(['Overall NPS Score based on grand total of all ' + (groupByBU ? 'business units' : 'customers')]);
      const achievedNPSDescRowNum = achievedNPSDescRow.number;
      achievedNPSDescRow.getCell(1).font = { size: 12, color: { argb: 'FF6B7280' } };
      achievedNPSDescRow.getCell(1).alignment = { horizontal: 'left', vertical: 'middle', wrapText: true };
      achievedNPSDescRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF9FAFB' } };
      achievedNPSDescRow.height = 25;
      worksheet.mergeCells(`A${achievedNPSDescRowNum}:F${achievedNPSDescRowNum}`);


      // Add Top 5 Accounts (only for account-wise data)
      let topAccountsStartRow = null;
      let topAccountsEndRow = null;

        });
        
        topAccountsEndRow = worksheet.lastRow.number;
      }
      
      // Add blue borders only to the outer edges of the summary section
      const summaryEndRow = topAccountsStartRow ? topAccountsStartRow - 1 : worksheet.lastRow.number;
      
      // Add borders only to the outer perimeter for NPS Dashboard Summary
      for (let rowNum = summaryStartRow; rowNum <= summaryEndRow; rowNum++) {
        const row = worksheet.getRow(rowNum);
        
        // Top and bottom rows get full borders
        if (rowNum === summaryStartRow || rowNum === summaryEndRow) {
          for (let colNum = 1; colNum <= 6; colNum++) {
            const cell = row.getCell(colNum);
            cell.border = {

          const rightCell = row.getCell(6);
          
          leftCell.border = {

            bottom: { style: 'none' },
            left: { style: 'none' },
            right: { style: 'medium', color: { argb: 'FF1D4ED8' } }
          };

      // Add blue borders only to the outer edges of the Top 5 Accounts section
      if (topAccountsStartRow && topAccountsEndRow) {

          const row = worksheet.getRow(rowNum);
          
          // Only the title row gets full borders

};

export default NPSDashboard;

## ✅ **NPS Dashboard SNO Ordering Fixed!**

### **🔧 Issue Fixed:**

**Problem**: After sorting by "Business Unit" in the NPS Dashboard, the SNO (Serial Number) column was showing incorrect order numbers.

**Root Cause**: The SNO was using `index + 1` from the map function, but when sorting occurred, the original indices were preserved instead of being renumbered.

### **📊 Solution Implemented:**

**1. Enhanced Sorting Logic:**
```javascript
const sortedData = useMemo(() => {
  // ... existing sorting logic ...
  
  // Re-number the SNO after sorting (but preserve grand total at the end)
  const grandTotalIndex = sorted.findIndex(item => item.isGrandTotal);
  if (grandTotalIndex !== -1) {
    const grandTotal = sorted.splice(grandTotalIndex, 1)[0];
    const regularData = sorted.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      displayIndex: index + 1
    }));
    return [...regularData, grandTotal];
  }
  
  return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
    ...item,
    displayIndex: index + 1
  }));
}, [processedData?.data, sortConfig]);
```

**2. Updated Table Rendering:**
```javascript
<TableCell isFirstColumn>
  {group.isGrandTotal ? 'TOTAL' : (group.displayIndex || index + 1)}
</TableCell>
```

**3. Updated Excel Export:**
```javascript
group.isGrandTotal ? 'TOTAL' : (group.displayIndex || index + 1)
```

### **🎯 Key Features:**

✅ **Sequential SNO**: SNO numbers now start from 1 and increment sequentially after sorting
✅ **Grand Total Preservation**: Grand total row remains at the bottom with "TOTAL" label
✅ **Excel Consistency**: Downloaded Excel file also shows correct SNO ordering
✅ **Fallback Logic**: Uses `displayIndex` when available, falls back to `index + 1` for compatibility

### **📈 Result:**

- **Before**: SNO showed random numbers like 1, 5, 2, 8, 3... after sorting
- **After**: SNO shows sequential numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5... after sorting
- **Grand Total**: Always appears at the bottom with "TOTAL" label
- **Excel Export**: Maintains the same correct SNO ordering

The NPS Dashboard now properly renumbers the SNO column after sorting, ensuring a clean and logical sequence!

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Parse MM-DD-YYYY format specifically
      const dateParts = dateString.toString().split('-');
      if (dateParts.length === 3) {
        const month = parseInt(dateParts[0], 10);
        const day = parseInt(dateParts[1], 10);
        const year = parseInt(dateParts[2], 10);
        
        // Validate the parsed values
        if (month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= 31 && year >= 1900) {
          const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
          
          // Parse cycle start date (assuming it's in MM-DD-YYYY format or standard date format)
          let cycleDate;
          if (cycleStartDate.includes('-') && cycleStartDate.split('-').length === 3) {
            const cycleParts = cycleStartDate.split('-');
            const cycleMonth = parseInt(cycleParts[0], 10);
            const cycleDay = parseInt(cycleParts[1], 10);
            const cycleYear = parseInt(cycleParts[2], 10);
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleYear, cycleMonth - 1, cycleDay);
          } else {
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
          }
          
          console.log('Date comparison:', {
            dateString,
            parsedDate: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            cycleStartDate,
            parsedCycleDate: cycleDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            isAfterOrEqual: date >= cycleDate
          });
          
          return date >= cycleDate;
        }
      }
      
      // If MM-DD-YYYY parsing fails, try standard date parsing as fallback
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
        return date >= cycleDate;
      }
      
      console.warn('Could not parse date in MM-DD-YYYY format:', dateString);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        // Debug summary
        console.log('Data processing summary:', {
          totalRows: dataRows.length,
          uniqueCustomers: finalData.length,
          totalSurveysSent: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0),
          totalSurveysReceived: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0),
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex,
          csatCycleStartDateFormatted
        });

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting
    if (sortConfig.key) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {sortedAndFilteredData.length} of {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
         <SearchInput
           type="text"
           placeholder="Search by account name..."
           value={searchTerm}
           onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
         />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Parse MM-DD-YYYY format specifically
      const dateParts = dateString.toString().split('-');
      if (dateParts.length === 3) {
        const month = parseInt(dateParts[0], 10);
        const day = parseInt(dateParts[1], 10);
        const year = parseInt(dateParts[2], 10);
        
        // Validate the parsed values
        if (month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= 31 && year >= 1900) {
          const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
          
          // Parse cycle start date (assuming it's in MM-DD-YYYY format or standard date format)
          let cycleDate;
          if (cycleStartDate.includes('-') && cycleStartDate.split('-').length === 3) {
            const cycleParts = cycleStartDate.split('-');
            const cycleMonth = parseInt(cycleParts[0], 10);
            const cycleDay = parseInt(cycleParts[1], 10);
            const cycleYear = parseInt(cycleParts[2], 10);
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleYear, cycleMonth - 1, cycleDay);
          } else {
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
          }
          
          console.log('Date comparison:', {
            dateString,
            parsedDate: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            cycleStartDate,
            parsedCycleDate: cycleDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            isAfterOrEqual: date >= cycleDate
          });
          
          return date >= cycleDate;
        }
      }
      
      // If MM-DD-YYYY parsing fails, try standard date parsing as fallback
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
        return date >= cycleDate;
      }
      
      console.warn('Could not parse date in MM-DD-YYYY format:', dateString);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          
          // Additional debugging for date validation
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Date validation for row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateType: typeof sentDate,
              receivedDateType: typeof receivedDate
            });
          }

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        // Debug summary
        console.log('Data processing summary:', {
          totalRows: dataRows.length,
          uniqueCustomers: finalData.length,
          totalSurveysSent: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0),
          totalSurveysReceived: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0),
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex,
          csatCycleStartDateFormatted
        });

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting
    if (sortConfig.key) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! Showing {sortedAndFilteredData.length} of {processedData.length} accounts
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
         <SearchInput
           type="text"
           placeholder="Search by account name..."
           value={searchTerm}
           onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
         />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
