const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Top 10 account names in order
  const top10AccountNames = [
    'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
    'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
    'Frontier Airlines INC',
    'Tufts Medicine',
    'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
    'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
    'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
    'BronxCare Health System',
    'Northern Trust Company',
    'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services JBFCS'
  ];

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Parse MM-DD-YYYY format specifically
      const dateParts = dateString.toString().split('-');
      if (dateParts.length === 3) {
        const month = parseInt(dateParts[0], 10);
        const day = parseInt(dateParts[1], 10);
        const year = parseInt(dateParts[2], 10);
        
        // Validate the parsed values
        if (month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= 31 && year >= 1900) {
          const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
          
          // Parse cycle start date (assuming it's in MM-DD-YYYY format or standard date format)
          let cycleDate;
          if (cycleStartDate.includes('-') && cycleStartDate.split('-').length === 3) {
            const cycleParts = cycleStartDate.split('-');
            const cycleMonth = parseInt(cycleParts[0], 10);
            const cycleDay = parseInt(cycleParts[1], 10);
            const cycleYear = parseInt(cycleParts[2], 10);
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleYear, cycleMonth - 1, cycleDay);
          } else {
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
          }
          
          console.log('Date comparison:', {
            dateString,
            parsedDate: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            cycleStartDate,
            parsedCycleDate: cycleDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            isAfterOrEqual: date >= cycleDate
          });
          
          return date >= cycleDate;
        }
      }
      
      // If MM-DD-YYYY parsing fails, try standard date parsing as fallback
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
        return date >= cycleDate;
      }
      
      console.warn('Could not parse date in MM-DD-YYYY format:', dateString);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          
          // Additional debugging for date validation
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Date validation for row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateType: typeof sentDate,
              receivedDateType: typeof receivedDate
            });
          }

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        // Debug summary
        console.log('Data processing summary:', {
          totalRows: dataRows.length,
          uniqueCustomers: finalData.length,
          totalSurveysSent: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0),
          totalSurveysReceived: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0),
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex,
          csatCycleStartDateFormatted,
          dateFilteringEnabled: !!csatCycleStartDateFormatted
        });

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply Top 10 filtering
    if (showTop10) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        top10AccountNames.includes(row.customerName)
      );
      
      // Sort by the predefined order
      filtered = filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aIndex = top10AccountNames.indexOf(a.customerName);
        const bIndex = top10AccountNames.indexOf(b.customerName);
        return aIndex - bIndex;
      });
    }
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting (only if not Top 10 mode)
    if (sortConfig.key && !showTop10) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig, showTop10, top10AccountNames]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>{showTop10 ? '🏆 Top 10 Account - Response Rate' : '📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate'}</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <Top10Button onClick={() => setShowTop10(!showTop10)}>
              🏆 {showTop10 ? 'Show All Accounts' : 'Top 10 Account - Response Rate'}
            </Top10Button>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! {showTop10 ? `Showing Top 10 accounts: ${sortedAndFilteredData.length} of ${processedData.length} accounts` : `Showing ${sortedAndFilteredData.length} of ${processedData.length} accounts`}
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
        <SearchInput
          type="text"
          placeholder={showTop10 ? "Search by top 10 account name..." : "Search by account name..."}
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
        />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;

const ACSATResponseRateDashboard = ({ excelData, acsatCycleStartDate, acsatCycleStartDateFormatted, onBack }) => {
  const [processedData, setProcessedData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Top 10 account names in order
  const top10AccountNames = [
    'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
    'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
    'Frontier Airlines INC',
    'Tufts Medicine',
    'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
    'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
    'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
    'BronxCare Health System',
    'Northern Trust Company',
    'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services JBFCS'
  ];

  // Helper function to check if date is on or after CSAT cycle start date
  const isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart = (dateString, cycleStartDate) => {
    if (!dateString || !cycleStartDate) return true; // If no date filter, include all records
    
    try {
      // Parse MM-DD-YYYY format specifically
      const dateParts = dateString.toString().split('-');
      if (dateParts.length === 3) {
        const month = parseInt(dateParts[0], 10);
        const day = parseInt(dateParts[1], 10);
        const year = parseInt(dateParts[2], 10);
        
        // Validate the parsed values
        if (month >= 1 && month <= 12 && day >= 1 && day <= 31 && year >= 1900) {
          const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
          
          // Parse cycle start date (assuming it's in MM-DD-YYYY format or standard date format)
          let cycleDate;
          if (cycleStartDate.includes('-') && cycleStartDate.split('-').length === 3) {
            const cycleParts = cycleStartDate.split('-');
            const cycleMonth = parseInt(cycleParts[0], 10);
            const cycleDay = parseInt(cycleParts[1], 10);
            const cycleYear = parseInt(cycleParts[2], 10);
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleYear, cycleMonth - 1, cycleDay);
          } else {
            cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
          }
          
          console.log('Date comparison:', {
            dateString,
            parsedDate: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            cycleStartDate,
            parsedCycleDate: cycleDate.toISOString().split('T')[0],
            isAfterOrEqual: date >= cycleDate
          });
          
          return date >= cycleDate;
        }
      }
      
      // If MM-DD-YYYY parsing fails, try standard date parsing as fallback
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        const cycleDate = new Date(cycleStartDate);
        return date >= cycleDate;
      }
      
      console.warn('Could not parse date in MM-DD-YYYY format:', dateString);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error parsing date:', dateString, error);
      return true; // Include record if date parsing fails
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const processExcelData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        if (!excelData) {
          throw new Error('No Excel data available');
        }

        // Look for the "CSAT sent and received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT sent and received Report ';
        let worksheet;
        
        if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
          worksheet = excelData.Sheets[sheetName];
        } else {
          // Try alternative sheet names
          const alternativeNames = [
            'CSAT sent and received Report ',
            'CSAT sent and received Report',
            'Sheet2',
            'CSAT_Sent_And_Received_Report'
          ];
          
          for (const name of alternativeNames) {
            if (excelData.SheetNames && excelData.SheetNames.includes(name)) {
              worksheet = excelData.Sheets[name];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!worksheet) {
          const availableSheets = excelData.SheetNames ? excelData.SheetNames.join(', ') : 'No sheets found';
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file. Available sheets: ${availableSheets}`);
        }

        // Convert worksheet to JSON
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        if (jsonData.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the CSAT sent and received Report sheet');
        }

        // Find column indices
        const headerRow = jsonData[0];
        console.log('Available columns in header row:', headerRow);
        console.log('Header row length:', headerRow.length);
        
        const businessUnitIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('business unit')
        );
        const customerIdIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || 
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_id') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer id'))
        );
        const customerNameIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('customer_name') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('cust_nm'))
        );
        const sentDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat sent date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_sent_date'))
        );
        const receivedDateIndex = headerRow.findIndex(header => 
          header && (header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat received date') ||
                    header.toString().toLowerCase().includes('csat_received_date'))
        );

        console.log('Column indices:', {
          businessUnitIndex,
          customerIdIndex,
          customerNameIndex,
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex
        });

        // Check which required columns are missing
        const missingColumns = [];
        if (businessUnitIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('BUSINESS UNIT');
        if (customerIdIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER_ID or CUST_ID');
        if (customerNameIndex === -1) missingColumns.push('CUSTOMER NAME or CUST_NM');

        if (missingColumns.length > 0) {
          throw new Error(`Required columns not found in the Excel file: ${missingColumns.join(', ')}. Available columns: ${headerRow.join(', ')}`);
        }

        // Check for date columns (these might be optional)
        if (sentDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Sent Date column not found - surveys sent count will be 0');
        }
        if (receivedDateIndex === -1) {
          console.warn('CSAT Received Date column not found - surveys received count will be 0');
        }

        // Process data rows
        const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1);
        const groupedData = {};
        let customerCounter = 1;

        dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdIndex];
          const customerName = row[customerNameIndex];
          const businessUnit = row[businessUnitIndex];
          const sentDate = row[sentDateIndex];
          const receivedDate = row[receivedDateIndex];

          if (!customerId || !customerName) return;

          // Check if dates are on or after CSAT cycle start date
          const sentDateValid = (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(sentDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          const receivedDateValid = (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDate) ? isDateOnOrAfterCycleStart(receivedDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted) : false;
          
          // Additional debugging for date validation
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Date validation for row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateType: typeof sentDate,
              receivedDateType: typeof receivedDate
            });
          }

          // Debug logging for first few rows
          if (rowIndex < 3) {
            console.log(`Row ${rowIndex}:`, {
              customerId,
              customerName,
              businessUnit,
              sentDate,
              receivedDate,
              sentDateValid,
              receivedDateValid,
              sentDateIndex,
              receivedDateIndex,
              csatCycleStartDateFormatted
            });
          }

          if (!groupedData[customerId]) {
            groupedData[customerId] = {
              id: customerCounter++,
              customerId: customerId,
              customerName: customerName,
              businessUnit: businessUnit,
              surveysSent: 0,
              surveysReceived: 0
            };
          }

          // Count surveys sent (only if sent date column exists)
          if (sentDateIndex !== -1 && sentDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysSent++;
          }

          // Count surveys received (only if received date column exists)
          if (receivedDateIndex !== -1 && receivedDateValid) {
            groupedData[customerId].surveysReceived++;
          }
        });

        // Calculate response rate and create final data
        const finalData = Object.values(groupedData).map(row => ({
          ...row,
          responseRate: row.surveysSent > 0 ? (row.surveysReceived / row.surveysSent) * 100 : 0
        }));

        // Debug summary
        console.log('Data processing summary:', {
          totalRows: dataRows.length,
          uniqueCustomers: finalData.length,
          totalSurveysSent: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0),
          totalSurveysReceived: finalData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0),
          sentDateIndex,
          receivedDateIndex,
          csatCycleStartDateFormatted,
          dateFilteringEnabled: !!csatCycleStartDateFormatted
        });

        setProcessedData(finalData);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing Excel data:', error);
        setError(error.message);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processExcelData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  // Handle sorting
  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prevConfig => ({
      key,
      direction: prevConfig.key === key && prevConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
  };

  // Sort and filter data
  const sortedAndFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData;
    
    // Apply Top 10 filtering
    if (showTop10) {
      filtered = processedData.filter(row =>
        top10AccountNames.includes(row.customerName)
      );
      
      // Sort by the predefined order
      filtered = filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aIndex = top10AccountNames.indexOf(a.customerName);
        const bIndex = top10AccountNames.indexOf(b.customerName);
        return aIndex - bIndex;
      });
    }
    
    // Apply search filter
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(row =>
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
    
    // Apply sorting (only if not Top 10 mode)
    if (sortConfig.key && !showTop10) {
      filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
        let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' || sortConfig.key === 'customerName') {
          aValue = aValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
          bValue = bValue?.toLowerCase() || '';
        }
        
        if (aValue < bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return 0;
      });
    }
    
    // Re-number the SNO after sorting/filtering
    return filtered.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      id: index + 1
    }));
  }, [processedData, searchTerm, sortConfig, showTop10, top10AccountNames]);

  // Calculate grand totals
  const grandTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const totalSent = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysSent, 0);
    const totalReceived = processedData.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.surveysReceived, 0);
    const overallResponseRate = totalSent > 0 ? (totalReceived / totalSent) * 100 : 0;
    
    return {
      totalSent,
      totalReceived,
      overallResponseRate
    };
  }, [processedData]);

  // Export to Excel
  const exportToExcel = async () => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const ExcelJS = await import('exceljs');
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet(showTop10 ? 'Top 10 Account - Response Rate Dashboard' : 'Response Rate Dashboard');

      // Add headers
      const headers = [
        'S.No',
        'Business Unit',
        'Account Name',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
        'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
        'Response Rate %'
      ];

      const headerRow = worksheet.addRow(headers);
      headerRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF374151' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Add data rows
      sortedAndFilteredData.forEach(row => {
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
          row.id,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerName,
          row.surveysSent,
          row.surveysReceived,
          Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100
        ]);

        // Style response rate cell based on value
        const responseRateCell = dataRow.getCell(6);
        if (row.responseRate >= 75) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else if (row.responseRate >= 51) {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        } else {
          responseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
          responseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        }

        dataRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
          cell.border = {
            top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
            right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
          };
          cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
        });
      });

      // Add grand total row
      const grandTotalRow = worksheet.addRow([
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        'TOTAL',
        grandTotals.totalSent,
        grandTotals.totalReceived,
        Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100
      ]);

      // Style grand total row
      grandTotalRow.eachCell((cell, colNumber) => {
        cell.font = { bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF000000' } };
        cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };
        cell.border = {
          top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FF3B82F6' } },
          left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } },
          right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: 'FFD1D5DB' } }
        };
        cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', vertical: 'middle' };
      });

      // Style grand total response rate cell
      const grandTotalResponseRateCell = grandTotalRow.getCell(6);
      if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 75) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } }; // Dark Green >=75%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else if (grandTotals.overallResponseRate >= 51) {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } }; // Dark Amber 51%-74%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      } else {
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } }; // Dark Red 0%-50%
        grandTotalResponseRateCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      }

      // Add formula section
      const formulaStartRow = sortedAndFilteredData.length + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Calculation Formula']);
      const formulaTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 1);
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      formulaTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100']);
      const formulaRow = worksheet.getRow(formulaStartRow + 2);
      formulaRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      formulaRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFF8FAFC' } };

      // Add legend section
      const legendStartRow = formulaStartRow + 4;
      worksheet.addRow([]); // Empty row
      worksheet.addRow(['Response Rate Color Legend']);
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 1);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 14 };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF1E3A8A' } };
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Add legend items
      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red = 0% to 50%']);
      const legendRedRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 2);
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' } };
      legendRedRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber = 51% to 74%']);
      const legendAmberRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 3);
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' } };
      legendAmberRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green = 75% and above']);
      const legendGreenRow = worksheet.getRow(legendStartRow + 4);
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: 'FF059669' } };
      legendGreenRow.getCell(1).font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };

      // Set column widths
      worksheet.columns = [
        { width: 8 },
        { width: 20 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 25 },
        { width: 18 }
      ];

      // Generate and download file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `ACSAT_Response_Rate_Dashboard_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting to Excel:', error);
      alert('Error exporting to Excel. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingMessage>Loading response rate data...</LoadingMessage>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            <Title>📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate</Title>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
          <ErrorMessage>{error}</ErrorMessage>
        </Header>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <Header>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>{showTop10 ? '🏆 Top 10 Account - Response Rate' : '📈 Org level/BU wise dashboard for Response Rate'}</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <Top10Button onClick={() => setShowTop10(!showTop10)}>
              🏆 {showTop10 ? 'Show All Accounts' : 'Top 10 Account - Response Rate'}
            </Top10Button>
            <DownloadButton onClick={exportToExcel}>
              <Download size={16} />
              Download Excel
            </DownloadButton>
            <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to ACSAT
            </BackButton>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted && (
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: '0.5rem', 
            padding: '0.75rem', 
            background: '#f0f9ff', 
            borderRadius: '6px', 
            border: '1px solid #0ea5e9',
            textAlign: 'center',
            color: '#0c4a6e',
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
            fontWeight: '500'
          }}>
            📅 CSAT Cycle Start Date: {acsatCycleStartDateFormatted}
          </div>
        )}
        
        {processedData.length > 0 && (
          <SuccessMessage>
            ✅ Data loaded successfully! {showTop10 ? `Showing Top 10 accounts: ${sortedAndFilteredData.length} of ${processedData.length} accounts` : `Showing ${sortedAndFilteredData.length} of ${processedData.length} accounts`}
          </SuccessMessage>
        )}
      </Header>

      {/* Response Rate Calculation Formula */}
      <FormulaContainer>
        <FormulaTitle>📊 Response Rate Calculation Formula</FormulaTitle>
        <FormulaText>
          <strong>Response Rate % = (Number of CSAT Surveys Received / Number of CSAT Surveys Sent) × 100</strong>
        </FormulaText>
        <FormulaText style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          This formula calculates the percentage of surveys that were completed out of the total surveys sent to each account.
        </FormulaText>
      </FormulaContainer>

       {/* Search Container */}
       <SearchContainer>
         <Search size={20} color="#6b7280" />
        <SearchInput
          type="text"
          placeholder={showTop10 ? "Search by top 10 account name..." : "Search by account name..."}
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
        />
         {searchTerm && (
           <ClearButton onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')} title="Clear search">
             <X size={16} />
           </ClearButton>
         )}
       </SearchContainer>

       {/* Response Rate Color Legend */}
       <LegendContainer>
         <LegendTitle>📊 Response Rate Color Legend</LegendTitle>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Red = 0% to 50%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#d97706' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Amber = 51% to 74%</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
         <LegendItem>
           <LegendColor style={{ backgroundColor: '#059669' }} />
           <LegendText>Dark Green = 75% and above</LegendText>
         </LegendItem>
       </LegendContainer>

      <ScrollableTableContainer>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <tr>
              <TableHeaderCell>S.No</TableHeaderCell>
              <SortableHeader onClick={() => handleSort('businessUnit')}>
                Business Unit
                <SortIcon>
                  {sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : '↕'}
                </SortIcon>
              </SortableHeader>
              <TableHeaderCell>Account Name</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Sent</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Number of CSAT Surveys Received</TableHeaderCell>
              <TableHeaderCell>Response Rate %</TableHeaderCell>
            </tr>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {sortedAndFilteredData.map((row, index) => (
              <TableRow key={index}>
                <TableCell>{row.id}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.businessUnit}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.customerName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysSent}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.surveysReceived}</TableCell>
                <ResponseRateCell rate={row.responseRate}>
                  {Math.round(row.responseRate * 100) / 100}%
                </ResponseRateCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
            
            {/* Grand Total Row */}
            <GrandTotalRow>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>TOTAL</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalSent}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalCell>{grandTotals.totalReceived}</GrandTotalCell>
              <GrandTotalResponseRateCell rate={grandTotals.overallResponseRate}>
                {Math.round(grandTotals.overallResponseRate * 100) / 100}%
              </GrandTotalResponseRateCell>
            </GrandTotalRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ScrollableTableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default ACSATResponseRateDashboard;
